# Special Education Due Process Complaint Drafter

> A Claude plugin and skill (for Claude Chat, Cowork and Claude Code) that drafts an IDEA special education due process complaint from a folder of school documents, for any US state and the District of Columbia. It reads the IEPs, evaluations, prior written notices, progress reports, service logs and emails; confirms the facts with the person filing; looks up the state's filing procedure on its official pages; drafts the complaint as a pleading; checks that every date, figure and quotation is in the documents or the person's own words and that every element 34 C.F.R. § 300.508(b) requires is there; reviews the draft for errors; and delivers it as a PDF to file and a Word file to edit. It is for special education attorneys, legal aid organizations, advocates and parents. It is not legal advice and says nothing about how a complaint will fare.

Install in Claude (web or desktop app): Customize → Plugins → + → Add marketplace → add from repository https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint → install Due Process Complaint Drafter. Requires a paid plan (code execution, on by default). In Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint`, then `/plugin install due-process-complaint@due-process-complaint`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/README.md): what it produces, how it keeps facts honest, installation, frequently asked questions
- [The skill's procedure](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/SKILL.md): the steps Claude follows, from reading the documents to handing over the complaint
- [The form of the complaint](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/exemplar.md): caption, introduction, contact and residence information, statement of facts, statement of the problems, proposed resolution, signature, certificate of service
- [The review before delivery](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/review.md): what is checked that a script cannot catch

## Examples

- [California, filed by a parent pro se](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/tree/main/examples/river-oak): a complete run on invented documents
- [North Carolina, filed by an attorney](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/tree/main/examples/pine-hollow): a complete run on invented documents, with a one-year filing window and the state's petition form

- [Where to file, by state](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/STATES.md): for all 50 states and DC, the office that receives a special education due process complaint, its official filing page, address, email, fax, time limit and a filing note

## Optional

- [51-state filing research](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/state-rules.json): each state's official due process filing page (filingUrl), with the address, fax, email and portal as researched in 2026; looked up again every run
